recommended_path: Seychelles foundation under the Foundations Act 2009 (consolidated 20 Dec 2021), registered with SIBA (Seychelles Islands Authority / registered-agent framework); local NPOs register under the NPO Act 2013
entity_types: Seychelles foundation (Foundations Act 2009) — separate legal entity upon registration; the practical route for foreign founders
Local non-profit organisation under the NPO Act 2013 (direct statutory text not obtained this round — snippet-level only)

requirements.founders: Foundation council of 1 or more members (individual or legal person); no residence or citizenship requirement; the founder may be a council member but not the sole member
requirements.local_presence: A registered agent in Seychelles licensed as an International Foundation Services provider is required (standard SIBA foundation requirement); no physical office required
requirements.documents: Constitution (trust deed equivalent) with objects, council rules and distribution provisions; council appointment details; registered agent's consent

forms: SIBA foundation registration application via the licensed registered agent (agent files; no self-service portal confirmed)
